verdict.rationale: Floot ships an official remote MCP server for building and shipping full-stack apps from an AI chat, with tools covering logs, database reads, writes and migrations, schema pulls, checkpoints, and image generation, so a large share of UI workflows is programmable. Parity is not complete: secrets must be typed into a browser dialog via a floot.com link, checkpoint reverts are documented through the Checkpoint panel, and the probes found no public OpenAPI/REST API. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API, explicit UI/API parity coverage (secrets, publishing, domains, sharing, mobile builds), and independent corroboration.
